items.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: she takes more after the Ella Fitzgerald or Lee Wiley type of singing.

ctx.x: No. It’s a whole mixture of different styles. You’ll hear Dave McKenna on piano solos, whose style, you wouldn’t call him a Dixieland piano player or a traditional piano player;

and you have Becky Kilgore, and she’s a great singer, and you wouldn’t call her traditional or anything like that, she takes more after the Ella Fitzgerald or Lee Wiley type of singing. And some of the bands will not be really Dixieland bands, they’ll be sort of like classic jazz bands.

Do you, when we look at the players that are playing this kind of music today, it seems to be rare to see a black musician, a young black musician playing this kind of music. Do you have any thoughts on that?
